hooks.command: which apt-get > /dev/null 2>&1 && (dpkg -s libudev-dev > /dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libudev-dev cmake golang-go clang)
which rustup > /dev/null 2>&1 || curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none && . "$HOME/.cargo/env" && rustup show
